title: Wizard upgrade paths and a stone skill tree
changes: The wizard's tree now upgrades its three spells instead of adding new ones: two paths per school, three tiers (levels 3, 8 and 14), three ranks each.

Fire Bolt can split into more bolts, explode, pierce and cast faster; Blizzard can grow wider, last longer, freeze longer and tick faster; Thunder can fork into more strikes, cover more ground and stun longer.
The skill tree is drawn as winding stone paths with round stone medallions that glow in the school's colour once learned.
